headline: China Is a 'Danger Zone' for Japanese Cars: Toyota Cuts Production and Sales Forecast by 100,000 Units, Nissan Lowers by 130,000
summary: Toyota lowered its fiscal 2026 China production and sales forecast by about 100,000 units. Nissan revised its China sales plan down by about 130,000 units.
why: Toyota and Nissan are major Japanese carmakers, and China is one of the largest car markets in the world, so forecast cuts there matter for their earnings.
